agent_notes: The first normal-TLS request to the NIRF, search, and official-site hosts returned the managed proxy's exact self-signed certificate-chain error; curl --insecure was then used only for public GET requests to those expected domains.
The official college site has a complete named catalogue for B.A., B.Com., four M.A. specializations, and the Certificate in Fundamentals of Computer.

The official IGNOU Study Centre page states aggregate counts of 7 certificate, 6 diploma, and 7 degree courses and shows historical enrollment codes from 2021-2022, but it does not provide a complete current named catalogue; those programmes were not guessed or imported.

The official Short Courses page says content will be available soon. Because the official catalogue is therefore incomplete for the IGNOU and short-course offerings, course_catalogue_status is partial_official_website and record_status is manual_review.
No official page explicitly states programme duration, so duration is null for every course.
